name: Apex Conservation Grant Program
summary: Funds on-the-ground habitat conservation and restoration near Apex Clean Energy wind and solar projects in the US, such as grasslands, forests and wetlands. US nonprofits must bring at least 1:1 matching funds.

geography.label: Near Apex wind, solar and storage projects

reporting: Recipients must meet reporting and documentation requirements, and projects run over one to four years.

administered_by.quote: Apex Clean Energy endeavors to promote and increase the ecological benefits of our renewable energy projects.

applicant_types.quote: be a registered 501(c)(3) organization or other qualified not-for-profit in good standing with the IRS

geography.quote: Apex is expanding the renewable frontier across the United States

co_finance_required.quote: Grant applicants are required to secure additional local, state, or federal grant funds or in-kind contributions to match the conservation grant at a ratio of no less than 1:1.

reporting.quote: Grant recipients must comply with reporting and documentation requirements that the project will be implemented in a one-to-four-year period.
